_about: Weapon balance, release 2 (2026-10-20, docs/notes/weapon_balance_2.md): the AK-12 and the Socom16. The owner asked for 0.27a's nerf (damage 55 -> 50, armour penetration 45 -> 40), then, shown the AK-12 in each build at hand, decided "50 35 for ak-12": damage 0.27's 50, piercing 35, between 0.27d0's 40 and 0.28a2's 30 (0.28a2 rebalanced the whole game, so only the AK-12's own change is taken). Both rifles, wpn_ak_12 and wpn_ak_12_premium: bullet_damage 0.55 -> 0.5, bullet_pierce 0.45 -> 0.35 (f32 kept), and the lobby card's texts (prop 1 damage, prop 3 armour piercing). And the owner's rule (2026-10-20) that a premium weapon gives silver and nothing else: the premium's default modifications 2044 (reload time -15 %) and 2094 (reliability +25 %) go, 1230 (+10 % silver) stays. Also the Socom16 (the owner, 2026-10-20: "and also Socom16 75 -> 50", 0.28a2's cut): bullet_damage 0.8 (live and 0.26g stock; 0.27d0 has 0.75) -> 0.5 and the card's prop 1; its piercing 0.45 stays (0.28a2 also cut it to 0.35; the owner named the damage only).
